summary.en: A live chart streams past a pinned write head; once, a burst writes through in the accent and is marked on its peak, then the stream brakes to a dead stop.
summary.zh: 实时曲线从钉在右侧的写入头流过；中途一次突发尖峰用强调色写入并在峰顶钉上事件标记，随后流速刹停成真静止。

fits: A system that is live and has one event worth naming: a spike, an incident, the moment a change shipped.
notFor: Comparing values (there is no axis to read exactly); more than one event (a second burst cheapens the first).

intent.en: The system reads as alive without saying so, and the one event in it is noticed and named.
intent.zh: 系统“活着”不用说出口就看得出，其中唯一的事件被看见、被点名。

content.en: A title and unit (≤ 24 chars), one event tag (≤ 20 chars) with its value, six time labels and three level labels; the series itself is illustrative.
content.zh: 标题与单位（≤ 10 字），一个事件标签（≤ 8 字）和它的数值，六个时间标签、三个刻度标签；曲线本身是示意数据。

fits.zh: 一个实时运行、有一个值得点名的事件的系统：尖峰、故障、上线的那一刻。

notFor.zh: 比较数值（没有可精读的坐标轴）；不止一个事件（第二次尖峰让第一次贬值）。

pairs.note: another chart move for a different point; keep them in different sections

en: The burst happens once; a second one cheapens it.
Set readings and labels at film size (≥ 32 px, the main reading 120–176 px) and let the chart fill the frame, not a small card.
With another live-chart move in the same film, use each once and in different sections.
zh: 尖峰只发生一次，第二次就廉价了。
读数和标签按成片字号（≥ 32 px，主读数 120–176 px），图表撑满画面，别缩在小卡里。
同片还有别的活体图表手法时，各用一次并错开段落。

upstream.name: 示波流线
upstream.summary: 采样窗平移 8px/f + 余弦包络尖峰 + 刹停真静止
upstream.use: 数据叙事段落；分别讲"实时性"、"每个数字是一个人"、"增长装不下"

overlaps.note: a frame-level transition along a traced path; live-trace is a chart that streams in place
